component.name: Zelda3D
component.summary: Native launcher for Ocarina of Time and Majora's Mask 3D ports

description.p: Zelda3D runs the Ship of Harkinian and 2 Ship 2 Harkinian cores from one native launcher. On first launch it asks for the user's own compatible game images or ZIP archives and stores generated data in the operating system's user configuration directory.
